verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is dominated by consumer-facing Gemini Apps documentation (chat, image generation, Gemini Live, notebooks) and contains no first-party documentation of a headless mode, CI integration, or automation-friendly API/CLI usage. The only hint of a CLI tool appears in community complaints (gemini-comm-14, gemini-comm-15) about login failures for Workspace accounts trying to use 'Gemini CLI' for software development, which does not establish that headless/CI automation works.
